GREAT Invest Advantage (SP) is a guaranteed issued whole life single premium
About your plan
investment-linked plan (ILP). It is designed to meet your wealth accumulation needs while
enjoying insurance coverage. This plan provides coverage for death and terminal illness.
This plan gives you access to professionally managed ILP sub- funds (“funds") and this
allows the account value of your policy to potentially grow in the long term. Every ILP fund
has its own investment objectives, horizon, liquidity and level of risk. Do consider these
while selecting the fund(s). You are advised to select fund(s) that is/are more appropriate
to satisfy your individual budget, risk profile, financial needs and preference. The account
value of this plan will vary directly with the performance of the funds.
Please note that this product is an unlisted specified investment product.
GREAT Invest Advantage (SP) is provided by The Great Eastern Life Assurance Company
The provider of

Benefits
We will pay the following in one lump sum if the life assured dies:
Death benefit
(a) 110% of the single premium paid plus 110% of the total single premium top-ups (if any), less
110% of the total amount of partial surrenders made (if any); or
(b) the account value,
whichever is higher, less any debt (if any) under the policy.
We will pay the death benefit in one lump sum on a definite diagnosis of an illness that is expected
Terminal
to result in the life assured’s death within 12 months of the diagnosis.
Illness benefit
The diagnosis must be supported by a specialist and when we require, to be confirmed by our
appointed medical practitioner.

The unit price on each dealing day, i.e. a business day or such other day as we may decide from
time to time, will be based on the net asset value calculated by the relevant fund manager as
at the next valuation date for that fund. This means that we will not know beforehand the unit
prices at which instructions will be carried out.
Single-pricing basis, which is also referred to as bid-bid basis
The price at which units are created and the price at which the units are cancelled are based
on the bid price.
(b) Dealing deadline
The dealing deadline is 12 noon Singapore time on each dealing day or any other time we
decide by giving you at least 1 month’s notice.
For us to process your instruction on the same dealing day, we must receive your instructions
by the dealing deadline. If we receive your instructions after the dealing deadline, your
instructions will be deemed to have been received by us on the next dealing day.
As the unit prices of policy units of the funds may be in currencies other than the Singapore
dollar, we will convert the unit prices of these funds into Singapore dollars, at an exchange
rate decided by us, before buying or selling the policy units.

We will create and grant to you, the number of units in each fund of your choice, based on the
relevant bid price at the next valuation date.
Numerical example of how units are created:
Single Premium (SP) = S$1,000
Premium charge = 3.00% x S$1,000
= S$30
Net SP after premium charge = S$1,000 – S$30
= $970
Notional bid price per unit = S$2.000
Number of new units created = (970/2.000) units
= 485 units
Above example is for illustrative purpose and does not denote the minimum premium allowed.

unless dealings have been suspended as specified in the section “Suspension of dealings”
below.

Death benefit
We will not pay the benefit if the life assured dies due to:
(a) suicide, while sane or insane; or

We will terminate your policy and pay the account value calculated as at the next valuation date

Terminal illness benefit
We will not pay the benefit for:
(a) terminal illness in the presence of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection;
(b) pre-existing terminal illness; or
(c) a diagnosis of terminal illness due to a pre-existing condition within 12 months from the date
we issued the policy or date of reinstatement (if applicable).
You are advised to read the policy contract for the exact definitions, terms and conditions, and

chunks.heading: Death benefit
chunks.text:
Death benefit
We will not pay the benefit if the life assured dies due to:
(a) suicide, while sane or insane; or
(b) any pre-existing condition,
within 12 months from the date we issued the policy or date of reinstatement (if applicable).
We will terminate your policy and pay the account value calculated as at the next valuation date
following our receipt of notification of the death.

Terminal illness benefit
We will not pay the benefit for:
(a) terminal illness in the presence of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection;
(b) pre-existing terminal illness; or
(c) a diagnosis of terminal illness due to a pre-existing condition within 12 months from the date
we issued the policy or date of reinstatement (if applicable).
You are advised to read the policy contract for the exact definitions, terms and conditions, and
full list of exclusions.
Insurance coverage will be lost if your policy lapses.
